edits.before: Lulu wins the level 1-2 walk-up cleanly: her Glitterlance slow and long range let her poke Alistar as he tries to close, and he can never reach point-blank W-Q range without eating free damage. His mana bleeds fast walking up into nothing, so he concedes the early lane and plays for scaling.

edits.before: From 3-6 Lulu's Whimsy is the perfect answer to a telegraphed Alistar engage, polymorphing him the moment he commits his W-Q and turning his all-in into a wasted flash. Her E shield and slow further peel his approach, and at 6 Wild Growth knocks up his dive and grants so much health that his damageless all-in simply can't finish the target.

edits.before: In 2-item teamfights Lulu out-peels Alistar entirely: Whimsy cancels his engage, her ult knocks up and heals through his commitment, and her shields negate his Trample. He does no damage on his own, so even a landed knockup is undone by her buffs, keeping the utility duel firmly in Lulu's favor at every stage.
